corePassives.description:
Upon hitting the Kido Snare, Hinamori's special attack, Ultimate, and counterattack will ignite it, deal damage to nearby enemies, and grant the Insight state to the team. 
 Each ignition of the Kido Snare will extend the effect's duration by 5 seconds.
corePassives.name: Conflagration

corePassives.description: When there are 3 or more stacks of Insight, the team's Spirit DMG increases by an extra 13.5%~18%.
corePassives.name: Tactic

corePassives.description: Increases Ultimate Energy Charge Rate by 15%~20%.
corePassives.name: Full Bloom

skills.description:
Hinamori wields Tobiume continuously to ignite a distant flame per slash, dealing damage equal to 30%~75% of ATK over 4 strikes. If the enemy is near Hinamori when the attack is launched, also deals melee damage equal to 15%~37.5% of ATK to them. ~~Bombardment~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, press and hold basic attack 
 Hinamori releases a more powerful flame attack, dealing 47%~117.5% AoE damage. The skill can ignite Kido Snare and grant 1 stack of Insight to the team. 
 
 Hinamori has her Spiritual Pressure immediately filled to the maximum at the beginning of the battle and automatically gains Spiritual Pressure during the battle.
skills.name: Snap, Tobiume

skills.description:
Hinamori expands a 15-second Kido Snare woven through Hado at the target location. When Hinamori's special attack, counterattack, or Ultimate hits the Kido Snare, the snare will be ignited and deal damage equal to 53%~132.5% of ATK. 
 
 The snare will be expanded in front of Hinamori if the target is too far away. There can only be 1 Kido Snare on the battlefield.
skills.name: Combo Spell - Crimson Fire Net

skills.description: Hinamori wields Tobiume with full force, launching a huge, explosive flame at the enemy, which deals DMG equal to 150%~375% of ATK. If the attacks hits a Kido Snare, it ignites the snare and grants 2 stacks of Insight to the team.
skills.name: Tobiume Spurt

skills.description: Upon blocking an enemy attack with Bakudo, Hinamori counterattacks the enemy with Hado, dealing damage equal to 477.5% of ATK. If the counterattack hits the enemy successfully, it will grant a(n) 18.75% Spirit Damage Boost to the team for 20s. If the counterattack hits the Kido Snare, the snare will be ignited and grant 1 stack of Insight to the team.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Hinamori gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
